When she had became pregnant due to the act of accused No.1, both accused Nos. 2 and 3 administered some tablets and aborted her pregnancy etc.
In the FIR serious allegations are made against accuse Nos. 1 to 3.

Allegations against accused Nos. 2 and 3 are almost similar and it is also alleged that accused No.3 was giving injunction to the complainant and making her unconscious by giving tender coconut water mixed with some powder.
7. The incident is alleged to have taken place between 01.03.2022 and 22.10.2022.
Further statement of the victim was recorded on 02.11.2022.
In the said statement, victim has changed her version which was taken note of by this Court while allowing the bail petition preferred by accused No.1.
The said order passed by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Crl.A.No.541/2023 dated 30.06.2023 has been furnished.

It is pertinent to mention that in the further statement, the victim has taken a u-turn and stated that accused No.3 has not given trouble to her and she has not given injunction or powder etc. as stated in her complaint dated 22.10.2022.
The Police have deleted the name of said accused No.3, while filing the charge sheet.
Investigation is completed and charge sheet has been filed.
The appellant is a woman and she is in judicial custody since 23.10.2022.
Accused No.1 is enlarged on bail by this Court.
Accused No.3 has been dropped from the charge sheet.

9. The learned Sessions Judge while rejecting the petition filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. has observed that, the allegations made by the complainant against accused Nos. 2 and 3 are specific that they have wrongfully confined her for two months in a room and harassed her and used to send her forcefully to accused No.1 for satisfying his lust.

However, the name of accused No.3 has been dropped while filing the charge sheet and accused No.1 has been enlarged on bail by this Court.
10.
In the above facts and circumstances, the relief sought by the appellant can be granted by imposing suitable conditions.

Accordingly, the following:
NC: 2023:KHC:40939 ORDER i) The appeal is allowed.
ii) The order dated 19.04.2023 passed in Crl.Misc.No.221/2023 by the Court of First Additional District and Sessions Judge, Ramanagar is set aside.
